title: The database retains the previous snapshot and reports staleness by digest
summary: A database reader now keeps the previous per-record digests across a refresh that changed a source (a refresh with no change keeps them), and reports staleness(identity) as unchanged, changed, new, removed or unknown, exposes the retained index as previous(), and reports readiness(identity, subjectRevision) as current, previous or unknown; open(root, {previous}) seeds them in a later process from any ReadonlyMap of digests. A new capture store keeps the current and previous captured snapshots ({format: 'ia-snapshot-1', revision, membership}) under .ia/work/snapshot, independent of the graph cache and readable with the cache disabled: captureOf, writeCaptured (rotating current to previous only when the revision changes), readCaptured, readCapturedSnapshot and digestIndex. Store directories must lie under .ia/work/, with no path segment ending in a dot or a space (others are refused with IA-DB-PATH-UNSAFE), and the store writes a .gitignore only into a directory the write created. Writes are not locked: the last writer wins. New operational code IA-DB-SNAPSHOT-UNAVAILABLE.
